people.name: Shimei
people.line: Benjamite who cursed David during Absalom's rebellion.

translations.web: The king said to Shimei, “You will not die.” The king swore to him.
translations.bsb: So the king said to Shimei, “You shall not die.” And the king swore an oath to him.
translations.kjv: Therefore the king said unto Shimei, Thou shalt not die. And the king sware unto him.
